outcome: Neonatal composite outcome (neonatal intensive-care unit admission, low APGAR score, low umbilical cord pH, neonatal demise)
finding: There was no difference in the neonatal composite outcome between women with ≤10 PNV and those with >10 PNV.
mod_finding: Women with >10 PNV were more likely to undergo induction of labor and cesarean delivery.
